fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (ROOFTOP, 33.979548,-83.389046) lands on the main plant building of a multi-building industrial campus off Dairy Pak Road, Athens GA — confirmed at satellite z16-z19. This is the legacy Evergreen Packaging / Pactiv Athens carton-converting plant (Beverage Merchandising; gable-top carton stock).
fieldNotes.truckGate: The campus is bounded by fencing; the access roads (Dairy Pak Rd and the internal loop) reach the dock/yard area through controlled openings. A fenced compound with a chain-link gate and access-controlled entry is visible in Street View 2025-02 near the southwest entrance. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly identifiable multi-window staffed guard booth at the main entrance in satellite or Street View — the entrance reads as an open industrial-park-style gated entry with employee parking and landscaped islands. Flagged uncertain. Best read: no guard shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated/fenced campus with no confirmed staffed booth -> remoteGs = true. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Clear multi-building campus — main converting plant plus several adjacent manufacturing/warehouse buildings and ancillary structures (~6 distinct buildings).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur/line runs along the northeast edge of the campus alongside the main building; it appears to serve the property, consistent with a paperboard/carton plant receiving roll stock by rail. Flagged uncertain — cannot fully confirm the spur enters vs. runs adjacent.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors with trailers backed in run along the northeast face of the main building (orange/white trailers visible z18). Estimated ~20-25 across the campus. Low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Moderate trailer parking along the northeast dock apron and adjacent paved areas — banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A dedicated trailer-parking strip exists along the dock apron / NE side, separate from active dock positions.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Athens GA metro fabric — the campus sits in an established industrial district off Newton Bridge Rd / Dairy Pak Rd with dense surrounding development, neighborhoods, and other plants. Urban.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Entrance and internal roads are moderately constrained by the multi-building campus layout; limited obvious room to add a dedicated express lane.
